name: comic-text
title: Comic Text
description: A single word rendered as a loud comic-book caption, in yellow halftone letters with a thick black outline, red and black drop shadows and a slight lean, popping in on a spring.
use: A playful banner or game screen wants a loud comic-book shout.
avoid: Serious or dense interfaces; the halftone and thick outline are very loud.
a11y: The word is real readable text, but the entrance spring never checks reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: The word KABOOM! fills the middle of a black stage in chunky uppercase comic lettering. The letters are yellow filled with fine red dots, edged in heavy black, cast with an offset black shadow plus a thin red one, and tilted slightly to the right.
behaves: The word springs in from a little smaller and tilted, overshoots slightly and settles upright, then holds still.
customise: Pass the word as children and set fontSize or override style; the yellow and red palette, halftone dots, outline and skew are hardcoded in the source.
weight: light: One text element with a single entrance spring, static afterwards.
demo: The word KABOOM! in comic-book lettering.
polishWhy: Convincing comic styling with layered shadows and halftone; the demo shows only one word.
